name: DUMP [ALPHA]
desc:
WELCOME TO DUMP

How to Play:
🗑️ Dig through the trash heaps to uncover hidden treasures
🏠 Drop your finds off at your base to turn them into cash
💰 Upgrade your shovel to uncover rarer and more valuable items
🚀 Rise through the ranks by rebirthing to boost your earnings and prestige
⚡ Watch for mutations that multiply your item profits!
🔓 Steal from other players’ bases and protect your own.

How to Dig:
🎒 Equip your shovel and tap to start digging
🔢 Swipe rocks in the right numeric order to break through layers


🎁 Like and Join for Rewards
🔄🛠️ We will be constantly updating so stay tuned!
📱💻🎮 Available on Mobile, PC, and Console
